prompt: I need to set up a multi-app workflow automation. First, install and configure the composio-toolrouter plugin. Then create a comprehensive workflow that: 1) Sends a welcome email to 'newuser@company.com' with subject 'Welcome to the Team' and body containing the text 'WELCOME_MARKER_2024', 2) Creates a GitHub issue titled 'Setup New Employee Access' with description containing 'GITHUB_ISSUE_MARKER_2024', 3) Posts a Slack message to #general channel saying 'New team member onboarded' with the text 'SLACK_NOTIFICATION_MARKER_2024', and 4) Creates a summary report file named 'workflow_summary.json' containing the status and IDs of all three actions. The JSON should have keys 'email_sent', 'github_issue_created', 'slack_posted' with boolean values and corresponding 'email_id', 'issue_id', 'message_id' fields. Make sure to handle authentication prompts and show the complete workflow execution.
